tasks.instruction: Pick up the coffee mug from the island worktop and place it upright in the dishwasher upper rack.
tasks.init: mug on island worktop near west edge; dishwasher door closed
tasks.target: dishwasher upper rack region (x 0.10-0.45, y 3.40-3.90, z 0.55-0.75)
tasks.success: mug supported inside rack region, upright, door may close
tasks.fail: mug penetrates rack/door/floor or rests on floor
tasks.approach: from island west aisle, face +X toward dishwasher front

tasks.instruction: Fetch the cereal box from the pantry shelf and bring it to the island.
tasks.init: backup cereal box on pantry shelf level 2; decoy box already on island
tasks.target: island worktop region near east stools
tasks.success: pantry cereal box supported on island worktop region
tasks.fail: box left pantry region but never reaches island; box dropped
tasks.approach: through pantry doorway, frontal shelf approach, reach height 1.10 m

tasks.instruction: Move one piece of fruit from the fruit bowl to the dining table.
tasks.init: fruit in bowl on island worktop
tasks.success: at least one fruit supported on table top
tasks.fail: fruit on floor or penetrating tableware
tasks.approach: island east side, then dining table south edge

tasks.instruction: Put the plastic bottle and the tin can into the recycling pull-out bins.
tasks.init: bottle and can on island worktop; pull-out closed
tasks.target: pull-out bin volumes (plastic lane / metal lane)
tasks.success: both items inside their bin volumes, supported
tasks.fail: item on floor, item in wrong lane when task requires sorting
tasks.approach: island west, then waste pull-out front (face -X)

tasks.instruction: Open the refrigerator and take out the milk carton.
tasks.init: fridge door closed; milk on fridge shelf 2
tasks.success: fridge door >= half-open AND milk carton retrieved to front zone
tasks.fail: door forced beyond limit; carton dropped
tasks.approach: frontal, hinge west so swing moves away from approach line

tasks.instruction: Put the cereal bowl into the prep upper cabinet B.
tasks.init: bowl on island worktop; upper_door_b closed
tasks.success: bowl supported on cabinet shelf inside cavity
tasks.fail: bowl penetrates shelf/door; door closed onto bowl
tasks.approach: island west aisle, reach up to 1.65 m

tasks.instruction: Close every open door, drawer and pull-out in the kitchen.
tasks.init: reset sets fridge door open, dishwasher open, one upper open, one drawer open, pull-out open, pantry open
tasks.success: every joint within 0.5 deg / 5 mm of closed

tasks.instruction: Switch off the task lighting group and switch on the dining pendants.
tasks.approach: switch actuation at wall keypad (2.95, 0.10, 1.10) or API

uncertainties: Wood grain, stone speckle, plaster and brushed metal are procedural approximations, not scanned textures (visual-only).
Appliance interiors are simplified but real cavities; rack wire density is a suggestion, not a full model.
Collision proxies for curved props (faucet, plants, fruit) are conservative AABBs; visible meshes remain the truth for visual checks.
Fruit is modeled as smooth supershapes with procedural bump skin; stem geometry simplified.
Terrace puddles are thin water-film discs; drainage flow is implied by slope, not simulated.
Cable paths for toaster (pantry, no outlet) are coiled behind the unit; documented as visual-only approximation.
